notes: HEFSP adopted by Planning Board via Resolution R-13-25 on July 28, 2025 (extended from June 30 deadline). Prospective need reduced from DCA's 227 to 192; Court ruled on June 16, 2025 that borough's numbers were upheld (both FSHC and NJBA challenges resolved). Present need of 36 confirmed by Resolution R-58-25 and court order. Fourth Round RDP = 0: Vacant Land Analysis found ZERO available vacant parcels. Entire 192-unit prospective need is Unmet Need. Borough has NO Third Round plan; Third Round total obligation was 212 units; zero existing credits. Present/rehab need addressed through Bergen County Rehabilitation Program. Because RDP=0, the 25% site-zoning provision (53 units) would apply, but the HEFSP does not identify any specific overlay zones or site-specific affordable housing mechanisms for the Fourth Round. The only approved project mentioned (165-173 Ridge Road, Block 23, Lots 24/24.01/25) is a 15-unit multifamily under the Ridge Road Redevelopment Plan — but the HEFSP specifies NO affordable set-aside units for this project. Ord 2456 is a development fee ordinance only, not a site-specific overlay. This is effectively a site-less HEFSP with 192 units of unmet need carried forward.
